node.statement: Write D_n=tilde_gamma_n-gamma_n, h=K_hom, q=h/2, and k=K_norm. Decrease e_0 so that e<=1, ke<=1/2, and qe<=1. Node 1.3 and the preceding child give (1-(k+q)e)||X||<=||tilde_gamma_n(X)||<=(1+(k+q)e)||X||. Since the source unit has norm <=1+epsilon<=2, its unit defect is <=h e+q e||I||<=2h e. For multiplication, expand tilde_gamma_n(XY)-tilde_gamma_n(X)tilde_gamma_n(Y) as [gamma_n(XY)-gamma_n(X)gamma_n(Y)]+D_n(XY)-D_n(X)gamma_n(Y)-gamma_n(X)D_n(Y)-D_n(X)D_n(Y). The product-norm axiom, epsilon<=e<=1, ||gamma_n||<=1+ke<=3/2, ||D_n||<=qe, and qe<=1 bound the five contributions by h e, 2q e, 3q e, 3q e, and 2q e, respectively, times ||X||||Y||. Thus the multiplicative defect is <=6h e||X||||Y||. Together with exact involution preservation, every amplification is a C_tilde e-inclusion for C_tilde=max{k+q,2h,6h}.
